In conjunction with the words आयुक्त 'engaged', and कुशल 'skilful', when meaning entire absorption in an engagement, the 6th and the 7th case-affixes are used after a word.

Terms: विभक्ति-6, 7

The affix छ comes after a word denoting 'mountain' in the sense of 'this is his mother-land', when it is a person who lives by arms.

Terms: छ

The affixes छ and ठन् come in the sense of 'he conveys thereby' after the word आयुध।

Terms: छ and ठन्

To a name expressing multitude living by the trade of arms, is added the affix ञ्यट् when it is the name among वाहीक but not when it is the name of a ब्राह्मण , nor when the word is राजन्य।

Terms: ञ्यट्
